items.bullet_summary_preload:
- Israeli President **Isaac Herzog** picked **Gadi Eisenkot** on Saturday after parties representing 67 lawmakers recommended him, versus 46 for **Benjamin Netanyahu**, Reuters reported[5][3].
- Netanyahu's bloc won 53 seats to Eisenkot's 48 in the Oct. 27 vote, while Arab-led parties backing Eisenkot won a record 19[3].
- Caretaker Prime Minister Netanyahu warned against a government with "terrorist supporters"; the first test is set for Tuesday as the new **Knesset** convenes[1][6].

items.description:
Mass shootings are rare in Poland. The country has been on alert since October, when it saw a series of school attacks and stabbings that Tusk called a "cult of violence," AFP reported. Gun licences are rising quickly. More than 50,000 were issued in 2025, bringing the total to 411,000. Authorities have not yet said whether the suspect's weapons were legal.

Foreign leaders sent condolences,...
items.bullet_summary_preload:
- A gunman in military fatigues killed four women and two men on Krakow's **Main Market Square** on Saturday, wounding 16, including two officers, the AP reported[1].
- Interior Minister **Marcin Kierwiński** said the suspect, who was shot and detained by police, was fascinated with far-right ideologies and held "very radical views"[1].
- Prime Minister **Donald Tusk** urged politicians not to exploit the tragedy, which AFP called Poland's deadliest shooting since communism fell[5][2].
